intro: Mitsuwa is a Darkspear troll stationed at Zoram'gar Outpost along the misty coast of Ashenvale. Deeply troubled by the ambush of his traveling kin, he enlists Horde champions to avenge the fallen and reclaim stolen spiritual talismans.

p: Situated at the remote Zoram'gar Outpost on the strand of the Zoram Strand, Mitsuwa serves the Horde alongside his companion Marukai. When a group of traveling trolls bound for the encampment was ambushed and slaughtered by the aggressive Thistlefur furbolgs of northern Ashenvale, Mitsuwa took the loss as a grievous offense. Driven by duty and anger, he directs able-bodied warriors toward the Thistlefur dens to reclaim the stolen troll charms, ensuring the spirits of his kin are honored and their sacred possessions recovered from the beasts.
